notes.title: Minor Update - Mid September
notes.content:
Another small patch that fixes a few things (some major, some less so). Let's investigate!

-Fixed an issue where presenting the wrong evidence at the end of case 2 would cause a soft lock.
-Fixed an issue navigating the area in case 3 when the investigation phase had begun.
-Fixed whatever was going on with Morris' pants.

Switch update coming this week! Thanks for stopping by!

notes.title: Minor Update for September
notes.content: Hello! Just a small update for today. Besides the usual typo fixes, I've added some checks to hopefully solve a rare issue where evidence could fail to appear in the notebook. This is more of a temporary solution while I try to get to the bottom of what was actually going on, but it should help in a pinch. Most players probably won't notice a difference (hopefully).

notes.title: Dragon Detective: Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
The demo version of Dragon Detective: A Friend from the Shadows is now available for PC via Steam! The demo lets you start at the beginning of the game and play most of the first case (approximately 90 minutes of gameplay total). Your save will carry into the full game on Steam, too, letting you pick up where you left off in the demo.

[b]About Achievements:[/b] The full version of Dragon Detective features Steam achievements. Achievements acquired in the demo will trigger in the full game automatically at the point where the demo content ends. If you wish to unlock the "Mauve Mother" achievement in the full game, you will need to begin case 1 in the demo on Detective difficulty. You can also start over from the beginning of the case instead, if you wish.

[b]Controls:[/b] The game can be played with the mouse, or with a keyboard or gamepad. When using a keyboard or gamepad, you can control the virtual mouse cursor with the arrow keys/left analog stick. You can also snap the cursor between menu options (for instance, notebook entries or dialog responses) by using WASD/the directional pad. Use the "Help" button in-game for a full rundown of controls.

[b]Steamdeck Progress:[/b] Due to how the SteamDeck saves AppData files, you may need to copy your saves from the demo AppData folder to the full game's if the demo is played on the Steamdeck exclusively. The full game includes Steam Cloud functionality to sync up your saves, and continuing from the demo into the full game should work automatically on PC.

Thanks for checking out my game, and look for Dragon Detective in Steam Next Fest, Summer 2025!
